server_info.name: DCL Trust Oracle
server_info.description: Deterministic AI audit layer providing tamper-evident, privacy-first policy evaluation and post-action forensic decoding via x402 micropayments.

tools.name: evaluate_fast
tools.description: FAST Pre-Action Audit ($0.01). For high-volume, low-risk LLM outputs (e.g., summarization). Returns a tamper-evident tx_hash. Does NOT store raw content.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

policy.description: Policy to apply. Built-in options: 'default', 'anti_jailbreak', 'safety', 'content_quality'. Or provide inline YAML.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent making the request.

tools.name: evaluate_strict
tools.description: STRICT Pre-Action Audit ($0.05). For high-stakes outputs requiring deeper analysis and higher confidence thresholds.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

policy.description: Policy to apply. Built-in options: 'default', 'anti_jailbreak', 'safety', 'content_quality'. Or provide inline YAML.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent making the request.

tools.name: audit_decode
tools.description: POST-ACTION Basic Audit ($0.10). Verify a past decision by tx_hash. Returns metadata (verdict, confidence, agent_id, reason) without exposing original raw content.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash returned by a previous evaluate_fast or evaluate_strict call.

tools.name: audit_decode_deep
tools.description: POST-ACTION Deep Forensic Audit ($0.50). For detailed investigations. Provides everything in basic audit PLUS extended drift context, tamper-evidence indices, and environmental metadata.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash to investigate deeply.
